environment.description: Deployed in VPC subnet 10.200.44.0/24 with route table containing only local routes (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway, no VPC endpoints for S3/external services). The subnet's network ACL has explicit DENY on all egress to 0.0.0.0/0 except TCP 443 to the VPC CIDR range (10.200.0.0/16) for internal service mesh communication. DNS resolution is handled by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint restricted to internal hosted zones only. The Apollo server is fronted by an internal ALB (scheme: internal) which strips any response headers matching the pattern containing CR/LF bytes (0x0d/0x0a) via a custom Lambda@Edge-equivalent function on the internal ALB's target group response action. However, the PRIMARY mitigation is the network isolation: even if CRLF injection succeeds in poisoning a response to inject a redirect or exfiltrate cookies, there is no egress path for the attacker to receive exfiltrated data since the subnet has no route to any external destination.

config.header_sanitization: ALB response action strips headers with bytes 0x0d 0x0a
